A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MonoSOWA study and complete supplementary material. All 14 pages were inspected; pages 2–14 have identical extracted text and rendered content.

before.justification: v2 reports original detection experiments on KITTI, KITTI-360 and Waymo, along with ablations, runtime measurements and qualitative examples in the supplementary material.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, runtime measurements and qualitative examples reported in v2.

M1.justification: Section III retains the identical auto-labelling pipeline, Local Object Motion Model, Saturated Closeness Criterion and Canonical Object Space procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use KITTI, KITTI-360 and Waymo with the same vehicle-detection, pre-training, cross-dataset and supplementary test scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every matched experiment, including MonoFlex, MonoDETR, WeakM3D, Autolabels and VSRD in Table I, and DEVIANT in Table III.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, camera selections, AP/IoU metrics, training hyperparameters and experimental procedures are identical, including those used for supplementary ablations.

E4.justification: The component, human-mask, LiDAR, aggregation-length, steepness and focal-length ablations are unchanged. Runtime analysis and qualitative success/failure examples are also retained without revision.

E5.justification: Runtime variability reporting in Table IX is identical. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation or statistical-testing information is added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables I–XIV and qualitative predictions in Figures 6–8 are unchanged, as are the accompanying reported findings.

T1.justification: The assumptions, mathematical definitions, Equations (1)–(9) and Algorithm 1 are identical. No derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The claims about annotation-free training, motion modelling, approximately 700-fold labelling speed-up, dataset aggregation and pre-training benefits retain the same scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are identical, including the distant-object limitation in Section V and supplementary discussion of depth errors, aggregation length and false detections.

D1.justification: The abstract changes from saying the source code and model 'will be published soon' to stating they are available and providing the MonoSOWA GitHub link. This adds concrete access information; repository contents are not verified by the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: Section II, the 49 references and the positioning relative to prior methods are unchanged. The new project link does not add related research.

P1.justification: Editing is limited to the abstract's code/model availability sentence and the arXiv version/date stamp. The remaining prose and section structure are identical.

P2.justification: Page 1 gains a colored repository hyperlink and slight abstract line reflow, alongside the updated arXiv stamp. All figures, tables and the layout of pages 2–14 remain visually identical.

improvement.justification: Replacing a future-release promise with a concrete code/model repository link provides a limited improvement in access and reproducibility information. The scientific content and supplementary evidence are unchanged, and the PDFs alone do not establish the repository's contents or usability.
